subject: mushroom-shell beetle
pose: 三分之二侧面，一只小足抬起
art_direction: 小甲虫背着高低错落菌伞甲壳，橘红菌盖像雨衣兜帽，四肢短小不写实。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a small beetle character whose shell is formed from two overlapping mushroom caps, one rising like a raincoat hood above its face. Use a terracotta cap with sparse cream patches and a moss-green lower body. Give it short rounded legs and small antennae, with one foot lifted cautiously. The face should be modest and friendly, not insect-realistic. Paint broad gouache shapes with a few colored-pencil seams on warm paper. Keep the mushrooms and body unified into one readable silhouette, avoiding forest scenery, slime, or clusters of many tiny legs. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
